text: OpenCode | Browse, your real browser for coding agents Skip to content English 简体中文 Chinese, Simplified 繁體中文 Chinese, Traditional 한국어 Korean Deutsch German Español Spanish Français French Italiano Italian Dansk Danish 日本語 Japanese Polski Polish Русский Russian Українська Ukrainian العربية Arabic Norsk Norwegian Português (Brasil) Portuguese, Brazil ไทย Thai Türkçe Turkish Browse An MCP server and a Chromium extension that let your agents use your real browser, with your tabs, your logins and your extensions. They open tabs in the background, grouped out of your way, and read pages, click, type, take screenshots and record tabs. When it's your turn, for a login, a 2FA prompt or a payment, they hand the tab back to you and continue once you click Continue. Add to Chrome (opens in a new tab) View source (opens in a new tab) Your real browser Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc, Helium, Vivaldi, Opera and Chromium. Out of your way Agent tabs open in the background, in collapsed groups. Handoffs Do the login or 2FA step yourself, then click Continue. Lend a tab Click the toolbar button to hand an agent a tab you have open. Record and capture Screenshots, tab recordings and network traffic. Any MCP client OpenCode, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Zed and many more. All your logins Agents use the sites you're already signed into. No keys, no setup. Allowed sites Keep an agent's tab on the sites you name. Install Install the Chrome extension first. It walks you through the rest of the steps.
